items.title: 15.3.1 Generation and Transmission of Nerve Impulse (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the generation and transmission of the nerve impulse (PDF 30-32).

blocks.text: 1- Impulse se pehle: resting membrane potential

Aaram karta neuron (jo signal nahin le ja raha) polarized kehlata hai. Is ki andar ki taraf manfi aur bahar ki taraf musbat charge hota hai. Polarized neuron ke is membrane potential ko Resting Membrane Potential (RMP) kehte hain aur yeh taqreeban –70 millivolts (–70 mV) hota hai. Manfi nishan batata hai ke cell ka andar bahar ke muqable mein manfi hai. Aaram karte neurons mein RMP in wajahon se banta hai:

items: Bare manfi charge wale molecules, jaise proteins aur nucleic acids, cell ke andar zyada hote hain aur bahar diffuse nahin ho sakte. In molecules ko fixed anions (apni jagah jame hue manfi ions) kehte hain.

K⁺ ki miqdar neuron ke andar bahar se 30 guna zyada hai, jabke Na⁺ ki miqdar bahar andar se 10 guna zyada hai. Neuron ki membrane mein sodium-potassium pumps ATP kharch kar ke in ions ko un ke concentration gradient (zyada se kam ki taraf ka dhalaan) ke khilaf musalsal chalate rehte hain. Har do K⁺ jo andar laye jate hain, un ke badle teen Na⁺ bahar phenke jate hain. Is liye andar bahar ke muqable mein zyada manfi ho jata hai.
Kuch K⁺ ions membrane ke K⁺ gates se bahar bhi rees (leak) jate hain.

blocks.alt: Neuron aik daire ki shakal mein. Andar proteins aur nucleic acids 'fixed anions' (jamey hue manfi ions) hain. Andar wala electrode aur bahar wala electrode aik meter se jure hain jis par -70, 0 aur +90 likha hai. Membrane mein Na-K pump 3Na+ bahar aur 2K+ andar karta hai, aur dashed teer K+ ka risao (leakage) bahar dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.4: RMP ke zimmedar asbab (kitab ki Figure 15.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Intracellular electrode, Extracellular electrode, Proteins, Nucleic acids, Fixed anions, Neuron membrane, Leakage (K+), Na-K pump (3Na+, 2K+).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is figure mein teen wajahein dekhein jin se neuron ka andar manfi rehta hai: (1) proteins aur nucleic acids jaise bare manfi molecules andar phanse rehte hain, (2) Na-K pump har dafa 3 Na⁺ bahar aur sirf 2 K⁺ andar karta hai, is liye bahar zyada musbat charge jata hai, (3) kuch K⁺ khule raaste (leakage) se bahar nikalte rehte hain. Meter ki sui –70 par hai: yahi RMP hai.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: K⁺ ka yeh bahar nikalna aur manfi proteins ka andar ruke rehna hi andar khalis manfi aur bahar musbat charge, yaani RMP, banne ki sab se bari wajahein hain.
2- Impulse ka banna: active membrane potential

Jab neuron active hota hai (nerve impulse banata hai) to neuron ke ek hisse par membrane potential ulat jata hai, yaani andar bahar se zyada musbat ho jata hai. Ise Active Membrane Potential (ya action potential) kehte hain.
Action potential banne ke liye yeh waqiat hote hain:

items: Depolarization: membrane ke Na⁺ gates khulte hain aur Na⁺ ions tezi se cell ke andar daurte hain. Na⁺ ka yeh achanak andar aana andar ka manfi charge kam kar deta hai. Membrane ka potential –70 mV se sifr (zero) ki taraf jata hai aur phir +50 mV tak pohanch jata hai. Membrane ke dono taraf charge ka yeh ulat jana depolarization kehlata hai. Yeh depolarization neuron ke ek chhote hisse par taqreeban ek millisecond ke liye action potential banata hai.

Repolarization: thori der ke depolarization ke baad Na⁺ gates band ho jate hain aur K⁺ gates khul jate hain. Zyada K⁺ ions bahar diffuse hote hain aur cell ka andar dobara manfi ho jata hai. Ise membrane ki repolarization kehte hain (andar manfi, bahar musbat).

Hyperpolarization: repolarization membrane potential ko thori der ke liye resting potential se bhi kuch zyada manfi kar deti hai. Ise hyperpolarization kehte hain. Yeh is liye hota hai ke tamam K⁺ gates thori der se band hote hain. Is waqt (relative refractory period) neuron naya action potential sirf aam se zyada taqatwar stimulus se hi bana sakta hai.

Asal RMP par wapsi: thore se refractory period ke baad sodium-potassium pump ions ki asal tarteeb wapas laata hai aur membrane apne RMP, yaani –70 mV, par aa jati hai. Is tarah neuron ka woh hissa agle action potential ke liye tayyar ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai ke hyperpolarization ke dauran neuron doosra action potential bana hi nahin sakta aur yahi refractory period hai. Yeh poori tarah sahi nahin: absolute refractory period, jab koi bhi stimulus neuron ko fire nahin kar sakta, depolarization aur zyada tar repolarization ke dauran hota hai (Na⁺ gates band ho kar kuch der bekaar rehte hain). Hyperpolarization relative refractory period hai: is mein naya action potential ban sakta hai, magar sirf aam se zyada taqatwar stimulus se.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Action potentials ka aage barhna stadium ki "lehar" (wave) jaisa hai: har shakhs apni jagah rehta hai, khara hota hai (depolarize), haath uthata hai (action potential) aur phir baith jata hai (repolarize).

Haqeeqat mein action potentials (impulses) axon par safar nahin karte, balke axon ke saath saath agle hisson mein dobara bante hain. Axon ke ek hisse ka action potential agle hisse ke liye depolarization ka stimulus banta hai. Is liye agla hissa apna action potential khud banata hai. Isi dauran pichla hissa repolarize ho kar wapas RMP par aa jata hai.

blocks.alt: Membrane potential (-80 se +50 mV) aur waqt ka graph. -70 mV ke RMP (1) se curve tezi se +50 mV tak uthta hai (depolarization, Na+ andar, 2), yeh action potential hai; phir girta hai (repolarization, K+ bahar, 3), -70 se thora neeche jata hai (hyperpolarization) aur RMP par wapas aata hai (4). Chaar chhote panels stages 1 se 4 par Na+ aur K+ gates dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.5: Action potential ka banna (kitab ki Figure 15.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Panels ki ibarat kitab jaisi: 1 RMP par kuch K+ channels khule hain. 2 Na+ gates khulne se Na+ andar aata hai aur tez depolarization hota hai. 3 K+ gates khulte hain aur K+ ke bahar jane se repolarization hota hai. 4 Membrane ke asal RMP par lautne se pehle hyperpolarization hota hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph ko numberon se parhein: 1 par neuron aaram mein hai (–70 mV). 2 par Na⁺ gates khulte hain, Na⁺ andar daurta hai aur potential +50 mV tak chala jata hai: yeh action potential hai. 3 par K⁺ gates khulte hain, K⁺ bahar jata hai aur potential wapas girta hai. 4 se pehle chhota sa jhukao –70 se neeche jata hai (hyperpolarization), kyun ke kuch K⁺ gates der se band hote hain; phir pump halat ko RMP par le aata hai.

blocks.alt: Neuron aur us ke axon ki membrane ki aik patti paanch lamhon par, upar se neeche. Har patti membrane ke dono taraf + aur - charges dikhati hai. Pehle resting; phir aik hissa Na+ andar aane se depolarize hota hai (action potential); yeh hissa aage barhta hai aur peeche K+ bahar jata hai; peeche wala hissa hyperpolarized hota hai; aakhir mein membrane resting par wapas.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.5: Action potential ka phailao (kitab ki doosri Figure 15.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Cell membrane, Resting, Depolarization (Action potential), Hyperpolarization, Resting; Na+ aur K+ ke teer.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar se neeche patti waqt ke saath badalti hai. Neela hissa woh jagah hai jahan Na⁺ andar aa raha hai (andar musbat, bahar manfi): yahi action potential hai. Har agli patti mein yeh hissa daayen taraf barhta hai, aur peeche hara hissa hyperpolarized hai jahan K⁺ bahar ja raha hai. Is tarah impulse khud safar nahin karta, balke har agla hissa apna naya action potential banata hai.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab action potential ki choti (peak) +50 mV batati hai; kai kitabein taqreeban +30 se +40 mV deti hain.

blocks.prompt: Tarteeb dein: repolarization, resting, depolarization, hyperpolarization. Har active qadam mein kaun sa ion chalta hai, batayein.
blocks.explanation: Resting (–70 mV), phir depolarization (Na⁺ andar), phir repolarization (K⁺ bahar), phir hyperpolarization (K⁺ ab bhi bahar), aur phir pump se dobara resting.

items: RMP taqreeban –70 mV: fixed anions, Na-K pump (3 Na⁺ bahar, 2 K⁺ andar), K⁺ ka risao.
Action potential: Na⁺ andar (depolarization, +50 mV), K⁺ bahar (repolarization), had se zyada manfi (hyperpolarization), phir pump RMP wapas laata hai; har hissa agle hisse ko jagata hai.
